reasons: The function that creates holds, named evidenceHoldPatch, is not visible, so the logic is not reviewed.

terms.meaning: a flag that keeps a value out of display until a source confirms it

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Review ID and file header
sections.what: Gives the review a fixed name, and states that holds are data-quality decisions, not source facts.
sections.why: The header makes clear that a hold is an internal decision, not a claim from a source.
sections.watch_out: Changing the ID means old holds no longer match the review.

sections.name: HeldField
sections.title: Shape of a held field
sections.what: Defines one held field: which of three fields it is, its previous value, unit, currency, the reason, and the sources checked.
sections.why: Records enough detail for a person to decide whether to release the hold.
sections.watch_out: Only budget and delay fields can be held, as the list states.

sections.name: EvidenceReview
sections.title: Shape of a review record
sections.what: Defines the review with its ID, a fixed withheld state, and its list of held fields.
sections.why: Groups held fields under one review.
sections.watch_out: The state value is fixed, so a review in another state cannot be expressed with this type.

sections.name: Reviewable
sections.title: Fields a review can read
sections.what: Defines the subset of project fields a review looks at: industry, attributes, variances, the three held fields, and their approximation notes.
sections.why: Limits the review to the data it needs.
sections.watch_out: If a field is added to the project but not here, the review cannot see it.

sections.name: evidenceHoldPatch
sections.title: Building a hold on disputed fields
sections.what: Prepares the changes that place a project on hold while its numbers are re-checked against sources. It blanks the disputed fields, removes the stale numeric comparisons, and attaches a review record that lists the reasons and sources. It refuses to run if the stored value no longer matches the value that was reviewed.
sections.why: The stale-value check stops a hold from erasing a value that someone changed after the review was done. The function returns the changes as a set but does not save them itself.

summary: Defines the shape of records for source review holds: a field that is kept from display until its source is confirmed, and the review record that holds such fields.
purpose: Gives the review step a fixed structure for data-quality holds.
why: The header says holds are data-quality decisions, never facts reported by a source.
how: Defines a fixed review ID, the shape of one held field with its previous value and sources, the review record that lists held fields, and the subset of fields a review can look at.
inputs: None. This file only defines shapes.
outputs: Types and a fixed review ID.
risks: Only three fields can be held. A new field must be added to the type, or it cannot be held.
debug: If a hold is missing, check that the review ID matches the one used when the hold is written.
